slot.brief: Two gate circuit (e.g. NAND with inputs tied); build truth table and identify the equivalent single gate.

stem: A logic circuit consists of an AND gate and a NOR gate. Inputs A and B are fed to the AND gate. The output of the AND gate is connected to both inputs of the NOR gate. The final output Y is equivalent to which single gate?

verdicts.working: Let X = A AND B. The NOR gate receives X on both inputs, so Y = NOT(X OR X) = NOT(A AND B), which is NAND.

working:
First AND: Y1 = A AND B. Second NOR with tied inputs: Y = NOT(Y1 OR Y1) = NOT Y1 = NOT(A AND B) = A NAND B.

Independent check: Let X = A AND B. The NOR gate receives X on both inputs, so Y = NOT(X OR X) = NOT(A AND B), which is NAND.
solution:
The AND gate gives $X=A\cdot B$. A NOR gate with both inputs tied to $X$ gives
$$Y=\overline{X+X}=\overline{A\cdot B}.$$
Thus, the equivalent gate is NAND.
